description: This file defines the TransportSecurityState class and related components for managing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), Public Key Pinning (PKP), and Certificate Transparency (CT) policies within the Chromium networking code. It includes class declarations, enums, and method signatures for handling security state, pinning, and reporting.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState
classes.description: Manages in-memory store of HSTS, PKP, and CT policies, providing methods to query, update, and clear security states, as well as handle pinning and reporting.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::STSState
classes.description: Represents the strict transport security state for a domain, including upgrade mode, expiry, and subdomain inclusion.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::STSStateIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing the stored STS states.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PKPState
classes.description: Represents the public key pinning state for a domain, including hashes, expiry, and report URI.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::ReportSenderInterface
classes.description: Interface for asynchronously sending HPKP violation reports.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSet
classes.description: Defines a set of public key pins with associated metadata.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::PinSetInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a pin set, including hostname, pinset name, and subdomain inclusion.

classes.name: TransportSecurityState::RequireCTDelegate
classes.description: Interface for overriding CT requirement handling per host.

methods.name: SetTransportSecurityStateSourceForTesting
methods.description: Sets the source for transport security state, used for testing.
